sections.title: Balance sheet
sections.note: Sep 30, 2025 vs Dec 31, 2024 (since year-end) and Jun 30, 2025 (QoQ)

footnotes: Cash flow figures are reported year-to-date; each quarter is the year-to-date total less the previous quarter's.

Diluted EPS is not additive across quarters. Where the filing gives no three-month EPS (fourth quarters), it is calculated as net income to common ÷ estimated diluted shares (the full-year weighted average × 4 less the nine-month average × 3), and may differ from the reported figure by a cent or two.
Other operating expenses = gross profit − operating income − the expense lines shown.
The company reports no cost of revenue line, so net revenue flows straight to operating expenses.
Interest & other, net = pre-tax income − operating income. Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding. QoQ compares with Q2 2025; YoY with Q3 2024.
The company reports no revenue.
